reviews.summary: A core-contributor HYPE supply-release event is scheduled/modelled for November 6, 2026—three days after the snapshot. The amount is uncertain across trackers, but the near-term supply-event risk is directly relevant.
materialRisks: Near-term core-contributor HYPE unlock/claim window on November 6, 2026. Major trackers list the date, while reported modeled size is up to 9.92M HYPE; actual releases have materially differed from models. ([coingecko.com](https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/hyperliquid?trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block&utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: Hyperliquid’s official status page reports all systems operational and no incidents on November 1–3, 2026; the October 31 network-upgrade maintenance was completed. ([hyperliquid.statuspage.io](https://hyperliquid.statuspage.io/?utm_source=openai))

The reported November 6 unlock quantity is not confirmed: one tracker-based source describes 9.92M HYPE as a modeled ceiling, while DefiLlama showed no upcoming scheduled unlock in its November 3 snapshot. ([bluemediaworld.com](https://bluemediaworld.com/hyperliquid-hype-unlock-november-6-2026/?utm_source=openai))

Hyperliquid documentation states that moving unstaked HYPE from staking to spot takes seven days, so any recently initiated unstaking can create delayed spot availability. ([hyperliquid.gitbook.io](https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/onboarding/how-to-stake-hype?utm_source=openai))
